OSL_S.text: Oslo S (central station) Oslo S is Norway's largest station. Most long-distance trains have this as their terminus. Expand image Photo: Njål Svingheim, Bane NOR Travel information Open all Tickets Travel planning and tickets onlinePlan your journey and buy your ticket on the train companies' websites or the national travel planner Entur.Vy External linkFlytoget External linkGo-Ahead External linkSnälltåget External linkvy.se External linkSJ Sverige External linkSJ Norge External linkEntur External link Ticket sale Ticket office open Monday to Friday: 06:30 - 23:15, Saturday: 10:00 - 18:00, Sunday: 10:00 - 18:00. Ticket vending machines are also available. For trains to Stockholm and Sweden, you must buy a ticket in advance directly from the train company. To and from the station Airport Airport express trains depart from Oslo S every 10 or 20 minutes. Bus The bus terminal is ca. 200 metres away. The underground trains are ca 200 metres away. Car rental There is a Hertz-office at the station. Please visit the websites of individual car rental companies for more information. Taxi There is a taxi rank at the southern entrance to the station. Parking Parking There is a car park directly connected to the station. Kiss & Ride in Biskop Gunerius gate/under the Byporten mall by the taxi stop and Flytogterminalen (seaside by the taxi stop). There has been a station here ever since Norway's first railway opened from Kristiania to Eidsvoll in 1854. The station also contains a number of service offers in addition to the railway's own. There are many shops and restaurants here. The station changed its name from Oslo Ø to Oslo S in 1981. LLS.text: Lillestrøm station Lillestrøm station is centrally located in Lillestrøm. The station is central for local trains and Inter City, and is the only stop for the Airport Express train between Oslo and Oslo Airport. Expand image Photo: Sune Eriksen, Bane NOR Travel information Open all Tickets Travel planning and tickets onlinePlan your journey and buy your ticket on the train companies' websites or the national travel planner Entur.Vy External linkFlytoget External linkSJ Norge External linkEntur External link Ticket sale There are five ticket vending machines at the station. To and from the station Airport Airport express trains every 20 minutes. Bus Taxi Parking Bicycle stand Parking Number of parking spaces in total: 474 Commuter parking The number of parking spaces in Dampsagveien: 142 Commuter parking spaces for 250 NOK, is an offering to travelers with a valid period ticket (weekly, monthly or annual). Paid for using Bane NOR’s parking app. Learn more about commuter parking and the parking app. Travelers with single tickets can avail of day parking spaces in Damsagveien for 60 NOK per day (12 spaces in total). Paid for using Bane NOR’s parking app. Learn more about commuter parking and the parking app. Please note that signage in parking areas apply. Bicycle parking Gaining access to both of Lillestrøm bicycle hotel Download app “Bane NOR Parkering” in the App Store External link or on Google Play External link. Agree to terms and register payment method. Access is connected to your mobile telephone and applies to only one bicycle hotel. Once you have agreed to the terms, pres “LÅS OPP” in order to open the door to the bicycle hotel. Please note: the door may take up to 30 seconds to open. Access costs 50 NOK and lasts for 30 days. Your subscription will be renewed automatically when this time period expires. You will be notified by SMS before your subscription is renewed. For questions or service disruptions, please contact Bane NOR's Customer Service Center at +47 22 45 50 00 (Monday to Friday, 08:00–16:00). In case of service disruptions or problems accessing the bicycle hotel outside the Customer Service Center’s opening hours, please call the control center at +47 800 41 777.
